transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

Well, most nights I end up eating until I feel uncomfortably full, even though I keep telling myself to stop earlier. It's just really starting to bother me, and I realized I need some help to figure out how to break this cycle.
During these episodes of eating until you feel uncomfortably full, do you feel a lack of control over your eating, like you can't stop yourself even if you want to?

Yes, definitely. Once I get going, it feels like something else takes over and I'm just shoveling food in while I'm flipping records or scrolling on my phone. Even though I keep telling myself "this is the last bite," my hand just keeps going back to the food anyway.
How often do you experience these episodes of eating until you feel uncomfortably full, and do you typically do this in secret, or is it something you do openly?
This has been happening at least a couple of nights every week. I definitely do it in secret, timing it for when my wife is out or asleep so she doesn't see how much I'm actually eating.
During these episodes, do you also engage in behaviors like self-induced vomiting, laxatives, or excessive exercise to compensate for the calories you've consumed?

No, I don't do anything like that at all. I've never tried to make myself throw up or take laxatives, and I don't do any extra exercise to make up for it. Usually, I just end up feeling really heavy and sluggish and crash on the couch.
Do you often feel guilty or ashamed after these episodes of eating until you're uncomfortably full?

Yes, I feel a deep sense of shame and regret afterward, just sitting there uncomfortably full and thinking to myself, "you did it again." That embarrassment is actually the main reason I've started timing my eating so my wife doesn't see how much I'm putting away.
Can you tell me more about how long you've been experiencing these episodes of eating until you feel uncomfortably full, and have they been occurring regularly over the past few months?

It's been going on for about four months now, starting right around the time my wife took on her extra evening shifts and classes. It happens pretty regularly, at least a couple of nights every week. On those nights, I almost always end up in that same overstuffed, uncomfortable state where I feel like I've gone way too far.
Can you estimate how many times a month you have these episodes of eating until you feel uncomfortably full, and how long each episode typically lasts?

Since it happens at least a couple of nights a week, I'd estimate it's about 8 to 10 times a month. It doesn't usually happen in one quick sitting, but rather in little bursts where I keep going back to the kitchen over the course of the evening after I get home.
Can you clarify if these episodes of eating until you feel uncomfortably full are typically preceded by a period of dietary restriction or fasting, and if so, how often this occurs?

No, I don't restrict my food intake or fast before these episodes happen. That's not really something I have experienced or ever thought about doing. I just eat my regular meals during the day before this starts at night.
